verdict.rationale: Jeeves claims 'one-click sync with NetSuite, QuickBooks, and Xero', but only on the Instant Pay page, where it covers exported payment transactions. Card and expense data is otherwise reachable only through the API, webhooks, or CSV export, which means building your own integration. missing for 10: documented accounting sync for card transactions and expenses, evidence that sync is automatic or continuous rather than one-click, integration setup docs (e.g. field mapping), independent or hands-on corroboration.
